in_sanskrit.name: रान्जिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rājikā (राजिका) - राज (rāj) meaning ‘rule, reign, or king’, and का (kā) meaning ‘female’, so Rājikā means ‘Lady, Queen, or Lady of the Grove’. The name Ranjika comes from this Sanskrit root.

in_hindi.name: रांजिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rānjikā (राञ्जिका) - रान्ज (rānj) meaning ‘pleasing’ or ‘delighting’, and का (kā) meaning ‘female’, so Rānjikā means ‘She who pleases with the grove’ or ‘She who delights in the grove’. The name Ranjika comes from this Hindi root.

in_tamil.name: ராஞ்சிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rāñcikā (ராஞ்சிகா) - ராஞ்சி (rāñci) meaning ‘grove, wood, or forest’, and கா (kā) meaning ‘female’, so Rāñcikā means ‘Lady of the Grove’ or ‘She who resides in the grove’. The name Ranjika may also be transliterated as Randhika in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: రాఞ్జిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rāñjiki (రాఞ్జికి) - రాఞ్జ (rāñja) meaning ‘pleasing’ or ‘delighting’, and కి (ki) meaning ‘female’, so Rāñjiki means ‘She who pleases’ or ‘She who delights’. The name Ranjika may also be transliterated as Randhiki in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Ranjika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joyful, Radiant, Beautiful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranjika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ranja' meaning joy and 'Ka' meaning beautiful. It is a name that signifies the joy and radiance of life, and the beauty of the soul.

in_bengali.name: Ranjika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joyful, Radiant, Beautiful
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ranjika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ranja' meaning joy and 'Ka' meaning beautiful. It is a name that signifies the joy and radiance of life, and the beauty of the soul.
